subject: Minor optimization in kvstoreDictAddRaw when dict exists (#13054)
reason: The change is a pure refactor with no behaviour change: createDictIfNeeded now returns the dict pointer so kvstoreDictAddRaw avoids one redundant kvstoreGetDict lookup, with identical creation condition, allocated_dicts accounting and cumulativeKeyCountAdd path. The remaining hunks are comment typo fixes and a header-only parameter rename (threshold_ms to threshold_us) that documents the existing microsecond semantics. No command reply, data path, replication or persistence behaviour differs between the builds, so there is nothing a scenario could observe.
